audience: CMS users viewing contextual integration status for the active workspace

context.page: CMS is a contextual consumer of Workspace Admin integrations. Copy may link users to Workspace Admin, but must not imply CMS owns domain, API key, or webhook lifecycle.
context.domains: Verified domains are global workspace resources owned by Workspace Admin.
context.apiKeys: Workspace API keys are global workspace resources. Raw key values are shown once in Workspace Admin and are never revealed by CMS.
context.futureAutomation: Webhooks and deployment hooks are future Workspace Admin-owned capabilities. Keep this informational only.

security.secretPolicy: Never include raw API keys, key hashes, JWTs, internal audit fields, or stack traces.
security.linkPolicy: Workspace Admin links are built by code from allowlisted http/https origins or relative fallbacks; translators must not add URLs to message values.
security.htmlPolicy: Messages are rendered as text. Do not add HTML markup to catalog values.
